mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (order_no, shop_id, sku_id, sku_name, quantity, total_price, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{shopId}, #{skuId}, #{skuName}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, shop_id, sku_id, sku_name, quantity, total_price, status, pay_type, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, create_time, update_time FROM tb_order WHERE id = #{id}
